## Maintainer note

Ideas and contribution proposals are welcome via
[Issues](https://github.com/kgrizz-git/GUISkinDose/issues) or
[Discussions](https://github.com/kgrizz-git/GUISkinDose/discussions). Prefer
those channels over a cold PR unless the maintainer invited this pull request.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Checklist

- [ ] Maintainer invited this PR, this is a maintainer-owned change, or an Issue/Discussion already agreed a PR was wanted
- [ ] Change is focused; title describes the user- or maintainer-visible effect
- [ ] Worked from a feature branch / worktree (not direct commits to `main`)
- [ ] Ran the relevant tests, linters, and docs checks for this change
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` when behavior is user- or maintainer-visible
- [ ] Docs / help / registry updated if settings, exports, GUI copy, or agent guidance changed
- [ ] No PHI/PII, real clinical RDSRs, credentials, private URLs, or unapproved assets
- [ ] New third-party code/assets have license and provenance recorded where required
- [ ] If this affects dose calculation, input interpretation, exports, privacy, or compatibility: stated below and covered by tests or an explicit risk note
